config.title: FUNDA — Virtual Employee Directory

intro.title: FUNDA — Virtual Employee Directory
intro.body: In this lesson you will build a Virtual Employee Directory that renders a list of 10,000 employee cards with avatars, names, departments, and status badges without perceptible lag. Using Angular CDK's cdk-virtual-scroll-viewport, only the cards visible in the viewport are ever in the DOM. Combined with trackBy, OnPush change detection, and NgOptimizedImage for lazy avatar loading, you will produce a performant directory that feels native regardless of dataset size.
intro.usecase: Large list performance is one of the most frequently cited pain points in enterprise Angular applications — HR directories, customer lists, product catalogues, audit logs. Interviewers will ask how you have handled performance for large datasets.

objectives: Set up cdk-virtual-scroll-viewport with a fixed itemSize and a container height to enable viewport-only rendering
Replace *ngFor with *cdkVirtualFor and supply a trackBy function based on a stable employee ID
Apply ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush to the employee card component and explain why it is safe to use with immutable data
Use NgOptimizedImage with lazy loading to defer avatar requests until their card enters the viewport
Measure the DOM node count before and after virtual scrolling using Chrome DevTools Elements panel
Implement a live filter input that updates the displayed list without destroying and recreating the scroll viewport
Profile change detection cycles with Angular DevTools and identify which components re-render during a filter update
